description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

PMdigital.ai is seeking a Full Stack Developer I to join its growing team. The role develops and maintains secure, scalable, testable, and maintainable full-stack web solutions using C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core, including user interfaces, APIs, application services, and data-access layers. The developer will also collaborate in Agile teams to integrate, troubleshoot, document, deploy, and support .NET applications.
Full-stack .NET application developer building REST APIs, business logic, databases, and responsive web interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications using C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core
• Build RESTful web APIs, server-side services, business logic, and data-access components using Entity Framework Core and relational databases
• Develop responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or TypeScript, and an applicable framework such as Blazor, Angular, or React
• Apply secure coding, authentication and authorization, exception handling, logging, automated testing, source control, and code-review practices
• Collaborate in Agile teams to integrate, troubleshoot, document, deploy, and support .NET applications in cloud or enterprise environments

Requirements:
• C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core
• REST APIs, MVC, dependency injection, and middleware
• Entity Framework Core, LINQ, SQL, and relational databases
• HTML, CSS, JavaScript or TypeScript, plus Blazor, Angular, or React
• Unit and integration testing, Git, CI/CD, security, logging, and cloud deployment
• At least 1 year of relevant experience with an Associate degree, including hands-on .NET full-stack development using C#, ASP.NET Core, web APIs, front-end technologies, and relational data-access components
• Must be a U.S. citizen
• Must be able to obtain a public trust designation for access to sensitive, unclassified government information
